evidence.quote: Pick your stake on the bet strip and deal when you're ready.
Dealing you in: both dealer cards are face-down, as pontoon rules require.

criteria.why: Replies are short, plain dealer talk with no JSON, ids or tool talk. "Bet strip" is a small nod to the interface, and "as pontoon rules require" leans a little toward rule-citing.

evidence.quote: You twist and draw a 3 of clubs, making 20.

criteria.why: Every bet, twist and stick is acted on in the same turn, and the typed "Stick" at 16 is handled even though the surface showed no Stick button.

evidence.quote: the dealer finished on 19, so you win 100
they drew a 4 of hearts to 18 and stuck

criteria.why: The Croupier deals, plays out the dealer hand, reveals the cards and settles the bet itself. It never makes a bet or move choice for the player.
